title: clip on chickadee
text: clip on chickadee. These little guys are very realistic... from a distance... I was disappointed to see that they are very few actual feathers and that most of the bird is made out a velvet or other material.  That being said, from a distance it looks like a beautiful little chickadee.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
